Vendored so bootstrap does not fetch GitHub.

- `pins.txt` is the sha256 list CI checks. `tools/check_vendor_pins.py` fails when a `vendor/*.whl` digest, its `.sha256` sidecar, or a `voxprint-common==` pin in `pyproject.toml` or a `requirements*.txt` file disagrees with that list. The `pin` job calls the voxprint-common pin-check template `.github/workflows/pin-check.yml` with `tag: v0.7.0` and `lock: vendor/pins.txt`, so that list has to match the release wheel. The model-index job checks `mdl.json` against the signed index and the bundled `model-index.pin.json`. It does not run the pin check again.

- `voxprint_common-0.7.0-py3-none-any.whl`: the v0.7.0 wheel from Components local commit 241ac452 (not yet pushed or published as a GitHub release; sha256 `582ed667ef51896086b6f70c85148c525ea24b5c3dacb64f546a76486d311eca`). The sidecar `voxprint_common-0.7.0-py3-none-any.whl.sha256` matches this digest. It bundles the serial 10 unsigned model index (index head `15edeab0f7a874c27d2b38ef6ecb69106ff94df8`, sha256 `dab444f7d820b2611cb2aa1ec00ad8241a1ae41a4c68823aff793bfa0a72ce0e`) with Z-Image-Turbo marked default (revision a853c26eb946b9010b4bd142a2ad1439d83e7896), full Z-Image and MOSS-Image base/SFT marked optional, and the old mirror-z-image-turbo row retired, the voxprint-model/1 schema (sha256 e46ae56a…5138), the voxprint-app-models/1 schema (sha256 ed451b99…c420), and the index public key (`mdl/data/index-public.pem`). CI, docs, release builds and the Windows setup install it. The `gui` extra pins `voxprint-common[ui]==0.7.0`. The CI `pin` job checks out tag `v0.7.0` on voxprint-common; that tag is not on GitHub until Components pushes. `SUITE_APPS` includes `model-forge`. `voxprint-mdl-gui` is the windowed entry point. `paths.read_home()` does not fall back to the legacy home (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Voxprint`, `~/.local/share/voxprint`); the Windows setup moves it first (`installer/windows/migrate-home.ps1`), and Model Forge only uses `paths.home()`-based helpers, which migrate on first use. This wheel includes `voxprint-mdl cleanup` and `voxprint_common.worker`. Model Forge uses the worker for the Photos image check. It does not call `voxprint-mdl cleanup`.
